verdict.rationale: Wave advertises generic 'migration'/'onboarding' help when switching from other accounting software like FreshBooks (wave-docs-21, wave-docs-22), implying some support for historical data import, but there is no documentation describing how transaction-level detail, balances, or historical ledgers are actually preserved during migration. Missing for 10: technical migration/import specs, evidence of transaction-level fidelity, guidance on importing from systems other than FreshBooks, and any API/CSV import documentation supporting bulk historical data transfer.
